Name: Charter signed
Notes: Handbook Part II, Initiate. The charter in the project folder is signed by the Manager and the Approver. The project-charter skill sets the date from the plan.

Name: Kickoff
Notes: Handbook Part II, Execute. Walk the project team through the goal, workstreams, milestones, owners and how the team communicates. The project-charter skill sets the date from the plan.

Name: Weekly project team meeting
Notes: Handbook Part II, Execute. 30 to 45 minutes. Each person: done since last week, next week, blockers. Set this task to repeat weekly after import; the importer cannot.

Name: Status update to the Manager
Notes: Handbook Part III, status updates. Green, amber or red and why; on track; at risk; decisions needed and from whom; next two weeks. Set to repeat every two weeks after import.

Name: Close and lessons learned
Notes: Handbook Part II, Close. Confirm deliverables against the charter, run the 45 to 60 minute lessons-learned conversation, fill Template 6, archive the project. The project-charter skill sets the date from the plan.

Name: Name the owner after close
Notes: Handbook Part II, Plan. Who runs the work once the project closes, and what they need: documentation, training, access. For a data product, that is a standing project made from the Data team's product template. Dated with the close milestone.

Name: Help article or training
Notes: What the people who use the deliverable get before it is theirs. Dated with the close milestone.

Name: Comms to affected staff
Notes: Handbook Part III, close the loop. What changes for them, from when, and who to contact. Dated with the close milestone.

Name: Scope asks go here
Section/Column: Parking lot and outside the core set
Notes: Placeholder so the section imports. Delete it after import. A request that is not in the charter's scope lands in this section with a note pointing at the charter's out-of-scope list; it is evaluated, not added.
